request: The decompress middleware must decompress a request body whose Content-Encoding header is gzip written in any letter case, for example GZIP or Gzip.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(middleware): match gzip Content-Encoding case-insensitively (#3056)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > middleware/decompress_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestDecompressContentEncodingCaseInsensitive)$' ./middleware >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
